ctx.x: You know where Exchange Alley is. It's still here. It's still here? Yeah. I asked about that, something about it. She said, you know nothing about it.

Yes sir. I got there, you know. White folk come right side me, you know. Put his ears to the hall, you know. I didn't know he had something down in his head, you know. Soon I got right there at that alley, whoop. He sure half a brick. He was trying to trouble. He run to the crowd.
